audit.why: Lane difficulty is stated as EVEN (5.5/10) with clear early Hwei lead and late Seraphine teamfight edge, consistent with the level chart and win rate (50.75%).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Beat Drop as the matchup-defining cooldown but contains no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never mentions that Seraphine's W (Surround Sound) only heals on the second application after she's already shielded, which is the trigger for anti-heal timing.
audit.why: The kit gives real numbers: Beat Drop (E) is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, W is a flat 22s, R is 160/140/120s. The missingInteractions note flags that her sustain answers chip damage only once she's shielded — anti-heal timing hinges on that second cast, not the first.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldown numbers for E and R, and folded the W heal-trigger + Grievous Wounds timing into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Seraphine's Stage Presence (P) auto-attack reset is a readable wind-up tell before her combo, so players read the spell cast as the warning instead of the animation.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags this explicitly: the auto-reset wind-up is the cue to disengage, not the cast itself.
audit.corrected: Added the tell to the early-game content field.
